trainers.name: Joey
trainers.title: Youngster Joey
trainers.dialogue_intro: Hi! I like shorts! They're comfy and easy to wear!
trainers.dialogue_defeat: I lost?! My top percentage team!
trainers.dialogue_victory: Ha! I told you we were the best!

trainers.name: Haley
trainers.title: Lass Haley
trainers.dialogue_intro: You looked at me, so we have to battle!

trainers.name: Sammy
trainers.title: Bug Catcher Sammy
trainers.dialogue_intro: I spent all morning hunting Bug Pokemon in the trees!

trainers.name: David
trainers.title: Hiker David
trainers.dialogue_intro: Mountain climbing toughens you up! Let's see your stamina!
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Whoa! You knocked the wind right out of me!
trainers.dialogue_victory: Gwahaha! You need to train on the mountains!

trainers.name: Bob
trainers.title: Sailor Bob
trainers.dialogue_intro: Ahoy! The lake breeze makes my Pokemon eager for a bout!
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Washed out! You're a fine navigator!
trainers.dialogue_victory: Full steam ahead! Better luck on dry land!

trainers.name: Edward
trainers.title: Psychic Edward
trainers.dialogue_intro: I foresaw your arrival... and your imminent defeat.
trainers.dialogue_defeat: My vision was clouded... your power defies prediction.

trainers.name: Kira
trainers.title: Ace Trainer Kira
trainers.dialogue_intro: I only battle trainers who take strategy seriously. Ready?
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Incredible tactical execution. You've earned this win.
trainers.dialogue_victory: Good effort, but you need more synergy in your team.

trainers.name: Brock
trainers.title: Gym Leader Brock
trainers.dialogue_intro: I'm Brock! My rock-hard determination will test your limits!
trainers.dialogue_defeat: I took you for granted. As proof of your victory, take this!
trainers.dialogue_victory: Rock-solid defense! Come back when you've honed your skills.
